questions.prompt: Mean' Joe Greene was a 2x NFL DPOY, drafted from this small Texas school
questions.promptZh: Mean' Joe Greene 曾两获 NFL 年度最佳防守球员，并从这所德州小学校被选入
questions.story: Taylor, Texas, was the hometown of Mean’ Joe Greene, who was drafted by the Pittsburgh Steelers in 1969 and went on to win two NFL Defensive Player of the Year awards.
questions.storyZh: 德州泰勒是“Mean Joe”格林的家乡；他于1969年被匹兹堡钢人队选中，后来两次荣膺NFL最佳防守球员。

questions.prompt: Because of his father's basketball career, Ravens safety Kyle Hamilton was born on this European island best known for vacations
questions.promptZh: 由于父亲的篮球生涯，Ravens 安全卫 Kyle Hamilton 出生在这座以度假闻名的欧洲岛屿
questions.story: Baltimore Ravens safety Kyle Hamilton was born on February 17, 2000, in Saint James Parish, Jamaica, before moving to the United States and becoming an NFL star.
questions.storyZh: 巴尔的摩 ravens 后卫凯尔·汉密尔顿于2000年2月17日出生在牙买加圣詹姆斯教区，后来移居美国并成为NFL明星。

questions.prompt: Randy Moss signed to play for Marshall, but after serving 63 days in jail he landed with the Vikings here in 1997
questions.promptZh: Randy Moss 原本签约效力 Marshall，但在监禁 63 天后，于 1997 年加盟了这里的 Vikings
questions.story: After his 63-day jail sentence, Randy Moss was selected by the Minnesota Vikings with the 13th pick in the 1997 NFL Draft and began an eight-year tenure in Minneapolis.
questions.storyZh: 兰迪·莫斯服刑63天后，在1997年NFL选秀中以第13顺位被明尼苏达维京人队选中，并在明尼阿波利斯效力八个赛季。

questions.prompt: Before becoming NFL quarterbacks, Carson Wentz and Trey Lance both won national titles at this university
questions.promptZh: 成为 NFL 四分卫前，Carson Wentz 和 Trey Lance 都曾随这所大学赢得全国冠军
questions.story: Florida State won consecutive national championships in Tallahassee in 2013 and 2014, with Carson Wentz starring for the first title team and Trey Lance quarterbacking the second.
questions.storyZh: 佛罗里达州立大学于2013年和2014年在塔拉哈西连续夺得全国冠军，卡森·温茨是首个冠军队的核心，四分卫特雷·兰斯则率领第二支球队夺冠。

questions.prompt: Bears QB Caleb Williams was born and raised in this city
questions.promptZh: Bears 四分卫 Caleb Williams 出生并成长于这座城市
questions.story: Caleb Williams was born in Inglewood, California, on November 11, 2002, and grew up in the city before becoming the Chicago Bears’ quarterback.
questions.storyZh: 卡莱布·威廉姆斯于2002年11月11日出生在加利福尼亚州英格伍德，并在当地长大，后来成为芝加哥熊队四分卫。

questions.prompt: From 2006 to 2014, the NFL Draft spent 9 straight years here before it hit the road
questions.promptZh: 从 2006 年到 2014 年，NFL 选秀连续 9 年在这里举行，之后开始异地举办
questions.story: The NFL held its annual draft in New York City for nine consecutive years from 2006 through 2014 before moving the event to Chicago in 2015.
questions.storyZh: NFL年度选秀自2006年至2014年连续九年在纽约市举行，随后于2015年移往芝加哥。

questions.prompt: Lamar Jackson became the youngest player ever to win the Heisman Trophy at this school
questions.promptZh: Lamar Jackson 在这所学校成为赢得 Heisman Trophy 的最年轻球员
questions.story: On December 10, 2016, Lamar Jackson became the youngest Heisman Trophy winner in history at 21 years and 168 days while playing for Louisville.
questions.storyZh: 2016年12月10日，Lamar Jackson以21岁168天成为史上最年轻的橄榄球海斯曼奖得主，当时效力于路易斯维尔大学。

questions.prompt: Pat Tillman left a $3.6 million NFL contract in this city to enlist as an Army Ranger after 9/11
questions.promptZh: “9·11”事件后，Pat Tillman 在这座城市放弃一份价值 360 万美元的 NFL 合同，报名成为 Army Ranger
questions.story: Fresno State alumnus Pat Tillman turned down a $3.6 million NFL contract in 2002 to enlist as an Army Ranger; he was killed on April 22, 2004.
questions.storyZh: Fresno State校友帕特·蒂尔曼在2002年拒绝了价值360万美元的NFL合同，志愿加入陆军并成为游骑兵；他于2004年4月22日阵亡。

questions.prompt: The NFL's smallest-market team played 2 to 3 home games a year from 1933 to 1994 in this nearby city to boost revenue
questions.promptZh: 为增加收入，NFL 市场规模最小的球队曾在 1933 年至 1994 年间每年在这座附近城市举办 2 至 3 个主场比赛
questions.story: Baltimore’s Memorial Stadium hosted two or three games for the NFL’s Colts each year from 1933 through 1994, giving the league’s smallest-market club a stronger home presence.
questions.storyZh: 从1933年到1994年，巴尔的摩的纪念体育场每年承办两三场哥伦特队比赛，让这支NFL市场规模最小的球队拥有了更稳定的主场氛围。

questions.prompt: Adrian Peterson rushed for 1,925 yards as a 2004 freshman at this Big 12 school's town
questions.promptZh: Adrian Peterson 在 2004 年大一赛季便 rushing 了 1,925 码，当时效力于这所 Big 12 联盟学校所在的城市
questions.story: In 2004, Adrian Peterson rushed for 1,925 yards as a freshman at Baylor in Waco, launching a career that made him one of the NFL’s most accomplished runners.
questions.storyZh: 2004年，阿德里安·皮特森在沃科的贝勒大学以新生身份冲球1,925码，由此开启了他后来成为NFL杰出跑卫的生涯。

questions.prompt: Ashton Jeanty rushed for 2,601 yards and finished 2nd in Heisman voting while playing here
questions.promptZh: Ashton Jeanty 效力期间 rushing 了 2,601 码，并在 Heisman 评选中获得第二名
questions.story: In 2024, Ashton Jeanty rushed for 2,601 yards at Boise State and finished second in Heisman Trophy voting.
questions.storyZh: 2024年，阿什顿·金蒂在博伊西州立大学冲球2,601码，并获得海斯曼奖投票第二名。

questions.prompt: Before a 17-year NFL career, Ryan Fitzpatrick played quarterback at an Ivy League school in this city
questions.promptZh: 开启 17 年 NFL 生涯前，Ryan Fitzpatrick 曾在这座城市的常春藤盟校担任四分卫
questions.story: Before beginning a 17-season NFL career in 2003, Ryan Fitzpatrick was the quarterback at Cornell in Ithaca.
questions.storyZh: 在2003年开启长达17个赛季的NFL生涯前，瑞安·菲茨帕特里克曾是伊萨卡的康奈尔大学四分卫。

questions.prompt: The NFL franchise that began in 1919 as the Staleys of a small Illinois manufacturing city played its home games in this city
questions.promptZh: 1919年在伊利诺伊州一座小工业城市以“斯泰利队”之名创立的NFL球队，主场在这座城市
questions.story: The franchise was founded in 1919 by the Staley family, who ran a starch and animal-feed business in Decatur, and moved to Chicago in 1921 to play at Normal Park.
questions.storyZh: 该球队1919年由经营淀粉和饲料生意的斯泰利家族在迪凯特创立，1921年迁至芝加哥，在诺马公园球场比赛。

questions.prompt: In 1999, Mike Ditka traded a historic 8-pick package to bring Ricky Williams to this city
questions.promptZh: 1999年，Mike Ditka 送出历史级的8号签位组合，将 Ricky Williams 带到这座城市
questions.story: In 1999, New Orleans Saints coach Mike Ditka traded eight draft picks to Baltimore for running back Ricky Williams, one of the franchise’s most consequential deals.
questions.storyZh: 1999年，新奥尔良圣徒队主教练迈克·迪特卡用8个选秀权从巴尔的摩换来跑卫里基·威廉姆斯，这成为球队史上最重大的交易之一。

questions.prompt: A 1985 rap video recorded by the roster before a Super Bowl blowout became a pop-culture hit for the team here
questions.promptZh: 1985年，这支球队的全体成员在一场超级碗惨败前录制了一支说唱视频，并成为流行文化爆款
questions.story: The Irving-based Dallas Cowboys’ 1985 rap video featured the roster before its 46–10 Super Bowl XX victory and became a pop-culture hit.
questions.storyZh: 以欧文为主场的达拉斯牛仔队在1985年与全体队员共同出演了一支说唱音乐录影带，内容出现在他们以46比10赢得第20届超级碗之前，后来成为流行文化热门作品。

questions.prompt: Emmitt Smith, the NFL's all-time rushing leader, was born in this Florida city
questions.promptZh: NFL 历史 rushing 纪录保持者 Emmitt Smith 出生于佛罗里达州这座城市
questions.story: Emmitt Smith was born in Port St. Lucie on May 15, 1969, and finished his NFL career with a record 18,291 regular-season rushing yards.
questions.storyZh: 埃米特·史密斯于1969年5月15日出生在圣露西港，并以常规赛18,291码的冲球纪录结束NFL生涯。

questions.prompt: John Elway's 'The Drive' which went 98 yards to win the AFC Championship happened here in 1987
questions.promptZh: 1987年，John Elway 完成了著名的“The Drive”，推进98码并赢得 AFC 冠军
questions.story: On January 10, 1987, John Elway capped The Drive with a 98-yard touchdown pass as Denver defeated Cleveland 43–38 for the AFC championship.
questions.storyZh: 1987年1月10日，约翰·埃尔韦伊用一记98码达阵结束了那次著名的 Drive，丹佛以43比38击败克利夫兰夺得AFC冠军。

questions.prompt: A Thanksgiving football game has been an unbroken tradition since 1934 for the franchise in this city
questions.promptZh: 自1934年起，这座城市的球队的感恩节橄榄球赛从未中断
questions.story: The Detroit Lions have hosted a Thanksgiving Day NFL game every year since 1934, making it one of the league’s longest-running holiday traditions.
questions.storyZh: 底特律雄狮队自1934年起每年都参加感恩节NFL比赛，是联盟中最悠久的节日传统之一。

questions.prompt: The Fail Mary, decided by replacement refs on the final play, happened here in 2012
questions.promptZh: 2012年，决定比赛结果的“Fail Mary”（失败迈里）在这座城市上演
questions.story: The Fail Mary occurred in New Orleans on November 4, 2012, when replacement officials awarded the Giants a field goal after a controversial ruling involving Jim Harbaugh.
questions.storyZh: 著名的“Fail Mary”（失败迈里）发生在2012年11月4日的新奥尔良，替补裁判在涉及吉姆·哈博的争议判罚后判给巨人队一记射门得分。

questions.prompt: Super Bowl XVI, the first ever held in a cold-weather city, was played here at the Silverdome here in 1982
questions.promptZh: 1982年，首次在寒冷城市举行的 Super Bowl XVI 在这座城市的 Silverdome 举行
questions.story: Super Bowl XVI was played at the Silverdome in Pontiac on January 24, 1982, where Washington defeated Miami 27–17 in the NFL’s first cold-weather Super Bowl.
questions.storyZh: 第16届超级碗于1982年1月24日在庞蒂亚克的银穹球场举行，华盛顿以27比17击败迈阿密，这届赛事成为首次在寒冷城市举行的超级碗。

questions.prompt: This is the city where the NFL was founded in 1920, in a meeting above a candy shop
questions.promptZh: 1920年，NFL 在一家糖果店楼上的会议中诞生于这座城市
questions.story: The NFL was founded in New York on August 27, 1920, when representatives of 10 clubs met at the New York YMCA to create the American Professional Football Association.
questions.storyZh: NFL于1920年8月27日在纽约成立，当时10支球队的代表齐聚纽约YMCA，创立了美国职业橄榄球协会。

questions.prompt: Kurt Warner was stocking shelves for $5.50/hr in Iowa before winning the Super Bowl for a team in this city
questions.promptZh: Kurt Warner 曾在爱荷华州以每小时5.50美元的价格补货，后来为这座城市的球队赢得 Super Bowl
questions.story: Sioux City High School’s 1990 graduate Kurt Warner later quarterbacked the St. Louis Rams to victory in Super Bowl XXXIV.
questions.storyZh: 1990年毕业于苏克斯城高中库的库尔特·沃纳后来率领圣路易斯公羊队赢得第34届超级碗。

questions.prompt: Robert Crippen, the first NFL quarterback to throw for 3,000 yards in a season, was born in this city
questions.promptZh: Robert Crippen 是首位单赛季传球码数达到3,000码的 NFL 四分卫，出生于这座城市
questions.story: Robert Crippen was born in Vienna on April 21, 1956, and became the first NFL quarterback to pass for 3,000 yards in a season when he did so for New Orleans in 1980.
questions.storyZh: 罗伯特·克里彭于1956年4月21日出生在弗吉尼亚州维也纳，并在1980年效力新奥尔良时成为首位单季传球码数达到3,000码的NFL四分卫。

questions.prompt: Since 2017, college football fans in this city have waved to children watching from a hospital overlooking the stadium
questions.promptZh: 自2017年以来，这座城市的大学橄榄球球迷一直向俯瞰球场的医院里的孩子们挥手
questions.story: Since 2017, Jacksonville Jaguars fans have waved to children at Wolfson Children’s Hospital, which overlooks the stadium and has made their gestures a city tradition.
questions.storyZh: 自2017年起，杰克逊维尔美洲虎队球迷一直向俯瞰球场的沃尔夫森儿童医院里的孩子挥手，这一举动已成为当地的一项传统。

questions.prompt: In 2022, the Packers played their first international game at the only purpose-built NFL stadium outside the US, here
questions.promptZh: 2022年，Packers首次参加海外比赛，地点就是美国境外唯一专为NFL修建的球场
questions.story: On October 2, 2022, the Green Bay Packers played their first regular-season game outside the United States at Twickenham Stadium, defeating the New York Giants 38–20.
questions.storyZh: 2022年10月2日，绿湾包装工队在特威克纳姆体育场迎战纽约巨人队，以38比20获胜，这是他们首次在美国境外参加常规赛。

questions.prompt: In 2022, the NFL played its first regular-season game in Germany at this stadium
questions.promptZh: 2022年，NFL首场德国常规赛在这座球场举行
questions.story: On November 13, 2022, the Tampa Bay Buccaneers faced the Seattle Seahawks at Munich’s Allianz Arena in the NFL’s first regular-season game in Germany, losing 21–16.
questions.storyZh: 2022年11月13日，塔拉姆湾海盗队在慕尼黑安联球场迎战西雅图海鹰队，以16比21落败，这是NFL历史上首场在德国举行的常规赛。

questions.prompt: A 1970 plane crash killed 75 including 37 college football players headed home to this city
questions.promptZh: 1970年一场飞机失事造成75人死亡，其中包括37名准备返回这座城市的大学橄榄球运动员
questions.story: On October 10, 1970, Southern Airways Flight 242 crashed near Marshall, Texas, killing 75 people, including 37 Marshall University football players traveling home.
questions.storyZh: 1970年10月10日，南方航空242号航班在得克萨斯州马歇尔附近坠毁，机上75人死亡，其中包括37名返乡的马歇尔大学橄榄球队员。

questions.prompt: The NFL's only community-owned team has played here since 1957, at the league's oldest active stadium
questions.promptZh: NFL唯一由社区共同持有的球队自1957年起，一直在这座城市联盟最古老且仍在使用的球场比赛
questions.story: Green Bay’s Packers have played at Lambeau Field since 1957 and remain the NFL’s only publicly owned team, with fans holding shares dating back to a 1923 stock sale.
questions.storyZh: 绿湾包装工队自1957年起一直使用兰博球场，至今仍是NFL唯一由公众共同持有的球队，球迷持有的股份可追溯至1923年的股票发行。

questions.prompt: Joe Namath guaranteed a win, then upset the Colts in Super Bowl III in 1969 at the Orange Bowl in this city
questions.promptZh: 1969年Super Bowl III在这座城市的Orange Bowl举行，Joe Namath赛前保证获胜，随后爆冷击败Colts
questions.story: At Miami’s Orange Bowl on January 12, 1969, Joe Namath’s guaranteed victory was followed by the New York Jets’ 16–7 upset of the Baltimore Colts in Super Bowl III.
questions.storyZh: 1969年1月12日，乔·纳马思保证纽约喷气机队获胜后，球队在迈阿密橙碗体育场以16比7击败巴尔的摩马队，赢得第3届超级碗。

questions.prompt: Antonio Brown, the 4x All-Pro WR, was J.J. Watt's teammate at this university
questions.promptZh: 四届最佳阵容外接手Antonio Brown曾与J.J. Watt是这所大学的队友
questions.story: Columbus is home to Ohio State University, founded in 1870, whose Buckeyes football program became one of the most storied in college sports.
questions.storyZh: 哥伦布市是1870年创立的俄亥俄州立大学所在地，其Buckeyes橄榄球队后来成为大学体育中最负盛名的项目之一。

questions.prompt: The only NFL team ever to complete a perfect season played its home games in this city
questions.promptZh: 唯一完成全胜赛季的NFL球队曾在这座城市进行主场比赛
questions.story: The 1967 Oakland Raiders finished the regular season 15–0, then defeated the Houston Oilers 14–10 in Super Bowl II, becoming the only NFL team to complete a perfect season.
questions.storyZh: 1967年的奥克兰突袭者队以15胜0负完成常规赛，并在第2届超级碗中以14比10击败休斯敦油人队，成为唯一一支取得全胜赛季的NFL球队。

questions.prompt: Tom Brady won 7 Super Bowls, but was a backup in this college town
questions.promptZh: Tom Brady赢得了7届超级碗，但在这座大学城只是一名替补
questions.story: Tom Brady was a backup quarterback at Penn State in State College before going on to win seven Super Bowls in the NFL.
questions.storyZh: 汤姆·布雷迪在宾夕法尼亚州州立大学的州学院校区担任替补四分卫，后来在NFL赢得了7次超级碗冠军。

questions.prompt: The 1939 NFL Championship Game, the first ever, was won by the New York Giants over this city
questions.promptZh: 首届1939年NFL冠军赛中，New York Giants击败了这座城市的球队
questions.story: On January 15, 1939, the New York Giants defeated the Brooklyn Dodgers 23–20 in the first NFL Championship Game.
questions.storyZh: 1939年1月15日，纽约巨人队以23比20击败布鲁克林道奇队，赢得首届NFL冠军赛。

questions.prompt: Before being drafted in 2018, this QB threw for 4,948 yards in his last college season
questions.promptZh: 在2018年被选秀前，这位四分卫在大学最后一个赛季传出了4,948码
questions.story: Baker Mayfield threw for 4,948 yards at Arizona State in 2017 before being selected by the Cleveland Browns in the 2018 NFL Draft.
questions.storyZh: 贝克·梅菲尔德在2017年为亚利桑那州立大学传出4,948码，随后在2018年NFL选秀中被克利夫兰布朗队选中。

questions.prompt: After grenades ripped through his legs in Vietnam, Rocky Bleier was awarded a Purple Heart and won 4 Super Bowls for this city
questions.promptZh: 在越南被手榴弹炸伤双腿后，Rocky Bleier 获授紫心勋章，并为这座城市赢得了 4 次超级碗
questions.story: Pittsburgh Steelers running back Rocky Bleier received the Purple Heart after being wounded in Vietnam and later won four Super Bowls.
questions.storyZh: 匹兹堡钢人队跑卫洛基·布莱尔在越南受伤后获授紫心勋章，后来又随队四次赢得超级碗。

questions.prompt: The NFL Pro Bowl was held in this capital city from 1980 to 2009
questions.promptZh: 1980 年至 2009 年，NFL 职业碗一直在这座首都城市举办
questions.story: Honolulu hosted the NFL Pro Bowl for three decades, from 1980 through 2009.
questions.storyZh: 檀香山连续三十年承办NFL职业碗，时间从1980年一直到2009年。

questions.prompt: Joe Montana's 5 Super Bowl wins started with this Bay Area city
questions.promptZh: Joe Montana 的 5 次超级碗胜利始于一这座湾区城市
questions.story: Joe Montana won the first of his five Super Bowls with the San Francisco 49ers in the 38–16 victory over Miami at Super Bowl XIX in January 1984.
questions.storyZh: 1984年1月的第19届超级碗中，乔·蒙塔纳率旧金山49人队以38比16击败迈阿密队，赢得个人五个超级碗中的第一个。

questions.prompt: Peyton Manning chose this SEC school over Ole Miss, his father Archie's alma mater
questions.promptZh: Peyton Manning 选择了这所东南联盟学校，而非父亲 Archie 的母校 Ole Miss
questions.story: Peyton Manning played at Tennessee from 1993 to 1997, leading the Volunteers to the 1996 national championship after choosing the school over his father Archie’s alma mater, Ole Miss.
questions.storyZh: 佩顿·曼宁在1993年至1997年效力田纳西大学，并率队赢得1996年全国冠军；他选择这所学校，而非父亲阿奇就读的密西西比大学。

questions.prompt: Wentz and Lance both won national titles at this university
questions.promptZh: Wentz 和 Lance 都曾在这所大学赢得全国冠军
questions.story: Fayetteville is home to Fayetteville State University, an original member of the NCAA’s Alliance of American Football Conference when competition began in 2016; nearby Fort Bragg was renamed Fort Liberty in 2023 before restoring its historic name in 2025.
questions.storyZh: 费耶特维尔是费耶特维尔州立大学的所在地，该校也是NCAA美国联盟足球队在2016年成立时的创始成员之一；附近的布拉格堡于2023年更名为自由堡，并在2025年恢复历史名称。

questions.prompt: Patrick Mahomes grew up in this city where his father pitched in the minors
questions.promptZh: Patrick Mahomes 在这座城市长大，他的父亲曾在这里效力于小联盟
questions.story: Alvin was where Patrick Mahomes Jr. grew up and learned football from his father, former minor-league pitcher Pat Mahomes Sr.; the younger Mahomes later won Super Bowl LIV in February 2020.

questions.promptZh: Jim Brown 在这座城市的橄榄球和长曲棍球项目中都曾入选全美最佳阵容
questions.story: Jim Brown starred in both football and lacrosse at Syracuse, winning the Heisman Trophy in 1957 as the first Black recipient of college football’s greatest individual honor.
questions.storyZh: 吉姆·布朗在锡拉丘兹同时效力于橄榄球队和长曲棍球队，并于1957年成为首位赢得海斯曼奖的黑人大学橄榄球运动员。

questions.prompt: The Raptors' first franchise player, an expansion pick in 1995, was drafted out of this university
questions.promptZh: Raptors 队的首位建队球员是1995年扩军选秀选中的，他出自这所大学
questions.story: The Toronto Raptors began play in the 1995-96 season, and their first season was played at SkyDome, the domed stadium that made them the first NBA franchise to take its entire home schedule under a roof.
questions.storyZh: 多伦多猛龙队在1995-96赛季开始征战，他们的第一个赛季在天空穹顶球场进行，因此成为第一支把整个主场赛程都放在室内的NBA球队。

questions.prompt: In the 2011 NBA lockout, Deron Williams became the first All-Star to play overseas, joining Besiktas in this city
questions.promptZh: 2011年 NBA 停摆期间，Deron Williams 成为首位赴海外效应的全明星球员，加盟了位于这座城市的 Besiktas
questions.story: When the NBA locked out players in July 2011, Deron Williams became the first All-Star to take his talents overseas, signing with Besiktas in Istanbul while the league stalled.
questions.storyZh: 2011年7月NBA停摆时，德隆·威廉姆斯成为首位赴海外效力的全明星，他加盟了伊斯坦布尔的贝西克塔斯篮球俱乐部。

questions.prompt: In 2015, Frank Kaminsky's Wisconsin ended Kentucky's 38-0 season with a 71-64 Final Four win at this converted NFL stadium
questions.promptZh: 2015年，Wisconsin 在这座城市一座由 NFL 球场改建而成的体育场以71比64击败 Kentucky，终结其38连胜并闯入最终四强
questions.story: On April 4, 2015, Frank Kaminsky's Wisconsin beat Kentucky 71-64 at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, snapping the Wildcats' 38-game winning streak on the same field where the Indianapolis Colts play.
questions.storyZh: 2015年4月4日弗兰克·卡明斯基领衔的威斯康星队在印第安纳波利斯的卢卡斯油橄榄球场以71比64击败肯塔基，终结对手38连胜，而这座球场正是印第安纳波利斯小马队的主场。

questions.prompt: As a 9-seed, the 'Shockers' made a cinderella run to the 2013 Final Four representing this city
questions.promptZh: “Shockers”队以9号种子身份上演黑马之旅，代表这座城市闯入2013年最终四强
questions.story: A 9-seed Wichita State shock the 2013 NCAA tournament by reaching the Final Four, where the Shockers fell to Louisville, 78-68, after rising from 6-20 the previous season.
questions.storyZh: 作为9号种子的威奇托州立大学在2013年NCAA锦标赛中制造了灰姑娘奇迹闯入四强，但在决赛圈以68比78不敌路易斯维尔，而他们此前一季战绩仅6胜20负。

questions.prompt: This Big Ten stadium took its unusual name from a Union Army training camp used during the Civil War
questions.promptZh: 这座Big Ten球场的奇特名称源自南北战争期间使用过的联邦军训练营
questions.story: Michigan Stadium in Ann Arbor has been nicknamed the Big House since 1927, a name that came from the massive wooden barracks built by Union Army troops training on that ground during the Civil War.
questions.storyZh: 安娜堡的密歇根大学体育场自1927年起便被称为Big House（大屋），这一名字源于南北战争期间在此驻扎训练、修建起巨大木制营房的北方联邦军士兵。

questions.prompt: Mike Krzyzewski played for Bobby Knight at this service academy from 1965-69
questions.promptZh: Mike Krzyzewski于1965年至1969年在这所军校为Bobby Knight效力
questions.story: Mike Krzyzewski played point guard for the Army Black Knights at West Point from 1965 to 1969 under Bobby Knight, the same partnership that later defined Duke basketball.
questions.storyZh: 1965年至1969年迈克·沙舍夫斯基在西点军校为陆军黑骑士队担任控球后卫，主教练正是博比·奈特，这段师徒组合后来定义了杜克大学的篮球传奇。

questions.prompt: LeBron James announced 'The Decision' to join Miami on live TV in 2010 from a club in this town
questions.promptZh: 2010年，LeBron James在一家俱乐部现场直播中宣布“The Decision”，宣布将加盟新东家
questions.story: On December 23, 2010, LeBron James told ESPN viewers in Cleveland that he was taking his talents to South Beach, and The Decision instantly reshaped the NBA.
questions.storyZh: 2010年12月23日，勒布朗·詹姆斯在克利夫兰通过ESPN向全世界宣布自己将加盟迈阿密热火，这段被称为The Decision的宣言瞬间重塑了NBA格局。

questions.prompt: Kyle MVP, Jerry West aka 'The Logo,' was a 5x All-American at this college whose state shares his name
questions.promptZh: Kyle MVP和绰号“The Logo”的Jerry West曾是这所大学的5届全美最佳阵容球员，而这所大学所在的州与他的名字相同
questions.story: Jerry West was a five-time All-American at West Virginia from 1953 to 1959, and his dribbling silhouette became the NBA's official logo from 1969 until 1978.
questions.storyZh: 杰里·韦斯特在1953年至1959年间为西弗吉尼亚大学效力并五次入选全美最佳阵容，他运球的剪影从1969年到1978年一直被用作NBA官方标志。

questions.prompt: Stephen Curry made 4 three-pointers in the final 3 minutes as the USA beat France for gold in this city
questions.promptZh: Stephen Curry在最后3分钟命中4记三分球，帮助美国队在这座城市击败法国队夺得金牌
questions.story: Phoenix remembers the 1993 NBA Finals, when the Suns reached the championship series and pushed Michael Jordan’s Chicago Bulls to seven games before losing in Game 4.
questions.storyZh: 凤凰城让人铭记1993年NBA总决赛，当时太阳队闯入冠军系列赛，将迈克尔·乔丹的芝加哥公牛逼入抢七，才在第四场落败。

questions.prompt: Before becoming the NBA's first unanimous MVP, this guard led a tiny school here to the 2008 Elite Eight
questions.promptZh: 这位后卫在成为NBA首位全票MVP之前，曾率领当地一所小学校打进2008年精英八强
questions.story: Memphis State reached the 1973 NCAA championship game and faced John Wooden’s UCLA, a landmark achievement in the school’s basketball history.
questions.storyZh: 孟菲斯州立大学曾闯入1973年NCAA冠军赛，与约翰·伍登执教的UCLA正面对决，这是校史篮球最辉煌的篇章之一。

questions.prompt: A bobsled team from this tropical city qualified for the 1988 Winter Olympics despite never seeing snow before
questions.promptZh: 这支来自这座热带城市的雪车队尽管从未见过雪，仍成功获得1988年冬季奥运会参赛资格
questions.story: Kingston is the base of Jamaica’s celebrated bobsled program, whose two-man crew of Dudley Stokes and Michael White represented the island nation at the 1988 Calgary Winter Olympics.
questions.storyZh: 金斯敦是牙买加著名雪车项目的基地，达德利·斯托克斯与迈克尔·怀特组成的两人车队曾代表牙买加参加1988年卡尔加里冬奥会。

questions.prompt: Muhammad Ali's famous 'Rumble in the Jungle' victory over George Foreman took place in this African capital
questions.promptZh: Muhammad Ali在“丛林之战”中击败George Foreman的著名胜利发生在这座非洲首都
questions.story: On October 30, 1974, Muhammad Ali defeated George Foreman in Kinshasa’s famous Rumble in the Jungle, knocking Foreman down in the eighth round.
questions.storyZh: 1974年10月30日，穆罕默德·阿里在金沙哈的“丛林之战”中击败乔治·福尔曼，并在第八回合将对手击倒。

questions.prompt: Ivan Drago, the antagonist of Rocky IV, trained in this European capital
questions.promptZh: 《Rocky IV》中的反派Ivan Drago曾在这座欧洲首都接受训练
questions.story: Saint Petersburg, known as Leningrad from 1924 to 1991, supplies the bleak Soviet atmosphere that heightens Ivan Drago’s formidable presence in Rocky IV.
questions.storyZh: 圣彼得堡在1924年至1991年间以列宁格勒之名存在，其阴冷的苏联氛围强化了《洛奇四世》中伊万·德拉戈令人畏惧的形象。

questions.prompt: Canelo Álvarez, 4-belt undisputed super middleweight champion, was born in 1990 in the suburbs of this city
questions.promptZh: 这位拥有4条金腰带、undisputed（无可争议）超中量级拳王Canelo Álvarez于1990年出生在这座城市的郊区
questions.story: Canelo Álvarez was born in Guadalajara on July 17, 1990, beginning his rise from the western Mexican city to world boxing champion.
questions.storyZh: 卡内洛·阿尔瓦雷斯于1990年7月17日出生在瓜达拉哈拉，从这座墨西哥西部城市踏上通往世界拳坛冠军的征程。

questions.prompt: Oleksandr Usyk defeated Tyson Fury to become undisputed heavyweight champion in this city in 2024
questions.promptZh: 2024年，Oleksandr Usyk在这座城市击败Tyson Fury，成为 undisputed（无可争议）重量级拳王
questions.story: On May 18, 2024, Oleksandr Usyk defeated Tyson Fury in Riyadh to become the first undisputed heavyweight champion in the modern boxing era.
questions.storyZh: 2024年5月18日，奥列克桑德·乌西克在利雅得击败泰森·弗瑞，成为现代拳击史上首位公认重量级冠军。

questions.prompt: Before being stripped of all his titles, Lance Armstrong won cycling's biggest race 7 times, all finishing in this city
questions.promptZh: 在被剥夺全部冠军头衔之前，Lance Armstrong曾7次赢得自行车赛这项最大赛事，而终点都在这座城市
questions.story: Lance Armstrong won the Tour de France seven times, with every edition finishing in Paris, before his titles were stripped in 2012.
questions.storyZh: 兰斯·阿姆斯特朗曾七次赢得环法自行车赛，所有赛段都在巴黎收官，但他的冠军头衔于2012年被剥夺。

questions.prompt: Tiger Woods was born in 1975 in this city
questions.promptZh: Tiger Woods 于1975年出生在这座城市
questions.story: Tiger Woods was born in Cypress, California, on December 30, 1975, and grew up to become one of golf’s most celebrated champions.
questions.storyZh: 老虎·伍兹于1975年12月30日出生在加利福尼亚州赛普里斯，后来成长为高尔夫史上最著名的冠军之一。

questions.prompt: Bobby Jones and Alister MacKenzie transformed a former plant nursery into a legendary course in this city
questions.promptZh: Bobby Jones 和 Alister MacKenzie 将一座旧苗圃改造成了这座城市的传奇球场
questions.story: Bobby Jones and Alister MacKenzie converted a former plant nursery into Augusta National, whose first Masters Tournament was held in 1934.
questions.storyZh: 鲍比·琼斯和阿利斯特·麦肯齐把一座旧苗圃改造成了奥古斯塔国家高尔夫俱乐部，首届美国大师赛于1934年在这里举行。

questions.prompt: Phil Mickelson became the oldest major champion in golf history by winning the 2021 PGA Championship in this city
questions.promptZh: Phil Mickelson 在这座城市赢得2021年PGA锦标赛，成为高尔夫史上最年长的大满贯冠军
questions.story: At age 51, Phil Mickelson won the 2021 PGA Championship at Kailua-Kona, becoming the oldest major champion in men’s golf at the time.
questions.storyZh: 2021年，51岁的菲尔·米克尔森在科纳卢阿赢得PGA锦标赛，并成为当时男子高尔夫史上最年长的大满贯冠军。

questions.prompt: This city has been home to 'The Masters' every year since 1934
questions.promptZh: 自1934年以来，“美国大师赛”每年都在这座城市举行
questions.story: Augusta, Georgia, has hosted the Masters Tournament every year since its inaugural edition in 1934.
questions.storyZh: 自1934年首届赛事以来，佐治亚州奥古斯塔每年都会举办美国大师赛。

questions.prompt: Donald Ross designed the No. 2 course here, host to more golf championships than any other site in America
questions.promptZh: Donald Ross 设计了这里的2号球场，它承办的高尔夫锦标赛比美国任何其他场地都多
questions.story: Donald Ross designed the celebrated No. 2 course at Beverly Hills Golf Club, which has hosted numerous professional championships.
questions.storyZh: 唐纳德·罗斯设计了在比佛利山高尔夫俱乐部久负盛名的2号球场，这座球场曾举办过多项职业赛事。

questions.prompt: Before starting 99 straight major championships, Adam Scott was born in this southern hemispheric city
questions.promptZh: 在连续参加99场大满贯赛事之前，Adam Scott 出生在这座南半球城市
questions.story: Adam Scott was born in Montrose, Victoria, in 1980 and became the first Australian since Peter Thomson to win the Masters in 2013.
questions.storyZh: 亚当·斯科特于1980年出生在维多利亚州蒙特罗斯，并在2013年成为继彼得·汤姆森后首位赢得美国大师赛的澳大利亚人。

questions.prompt: The Open Championship regularly returns to The Old Course in this city where golf has been played since 1552
questions.promptZh: 英国公开赛经常重返这座城市的 The Old Course，自1552年以来这里便一直有人打高尔夫
questions.story: Golf has been played at the Old Course in St Andrews since at least 1552, and it is closely associated with The Open Championship.
questions.storyZh: 至少从1552年起，人们便在圣安德鲁斯的老球场打球，这座球场也与英国公开赛紧密相连。

questions.prompt: Kerri Strug, the gymnast whose 10.0 ended her 1996 campaign, was born in this Michigan city
questions.promptZh: 拿到10.0分并结束1996年征程的体操运动员 Kerri Strug，出生在密歇根州这座城市
questions.story: Kerri Strug was born in Bellaire, Michigan, on October 10, 1976, and received a perfect 10.0 for her final vault at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics.
questions.storyZh: 凯莉·斯特鲁格于1976年10月10日出生在密歇根州贝莱尔，并在1996年亚特兰大奥运会的最后一次跳马中获得满分10.0。

questions.prompt: Fresh off the 2024 Cup, the Panthers met the Stars in 2 NHL Global Series games at the Nokia Arena in this city
questions.promptZh: 刚赢得2024年Cup后，Panthers 在这座城市的 Nokia Arena 与 Stars 进行了2场NHL Global Series比赛
questions.story: Tempe is home to Arizona State University’s Sun Devils, whose program was founded in 1885 and became a major force in college sports.
questions.storyZh: 坦佩是亚利桑那州立大学太阳 Devil 队的所在地，这支球队创立于1885年，后来成为大学体育的重要力量。

questions.prompt: Before joining the Hurricanes in 1997, the NHL's Whalers spent 18 seasons here
questions.promptZh: 在这里效力18个赛季后，NHL的 Whalers 于1997年加盟 Hurricanes
questions.story: The Hartford Whalers played in Connecticut from 1979 through 1997 before moving to North Carolina and becoming the Carolina Hurricanes in 1997.
questions.storyZh: 哈特福德鲸鱼队从1979年到1997年在康涅狄格州效力，随后迁往北卡罗来纳州，并于1997年改名为卡罗来纳飓风队。

questions.prompt: A disputed 'No Goal' in triple OT of the '99 Stanley Cup Final still stings the blue and gold fans of this city
questions.promptZh: 1999年斯坦利杯决赛三加时赛中的争议“零进球”，至今仍让这座城市的蓝金球衣球迷心中刺痛
questions.story: On May 14, 1999, Dallas defeated Buffalo 3-2 when Brett Hull scored at 14:32 of the third overtime in Game 6 of the Stanley Cup Final; Hull’s disputed no-goal non-call in Game 5 remains equally infamous.
questions.storyZh: 1999年5月14日，斯坦利杯总决赛第六场，布雷特·赫尔在第三个加时赛第14分32秒进球，以3比2击败布法罗；第五场那次有争议的“无效进球”同样令人难忘。

questions.prompt: The Flames won the 1989 Stanley Cup for this city, which had just hosted the 1988 Winter Olympics
questions.promptZh: Flames 为这座城市赢得了1989年斯坦利杯，而这里刚刚主办过1988年冬奥会
questions.story: Calgary hosted the 1988 Winter Olympics, and the Calgary Flames responded the following year by winning the 1989 Stanley Cup.
questions.storyZh: 卡尔加里主办了1988年冬季奥运会，次年的1989年，卡尔加里火焰队便夺得了斯坦利杯。

questions.prompt: At just 19 years old, Yogi Berra fired rockets from a Navy boat onto this European beach during D-Day
questions.promptZh: 年仅19岁的 Yogi Berra 在诺曼底登陆日从一艘海军舰船上向这座欧洲海滩发射火箭弹
questions.story: On D-Day, June 6, 1944, 19-year-old Yogi Berra served in the U.S. Navy and fired rockets from a landing craft toward German positions off Normandy.
questions.storyZh: 1944年6月6日登陆日当天，19岁的耶奇·贝拉服役于美国海军，从登陆艇上向诺曼底外海的德军阵地发射火箭。

questions.prompt: Bobby Orr revolutionized hockey & won 8 straight Norris Trophies as a D-man. He's from this small town
questions.promptZh: Bobby Orr 革新了冰球运动，并连续8次当选 Norris Trophy 最佳防守球员，他来自这座小镇
questions.story: Bobby Orr was born in Parry Sound on March 6, 1948, and won eight consecutive Norris Trophies from 1968 through 1975.
questions.storyZh: 鲍比·奥尔于1948年3月6日出生在帕里桑德，并在1968年至1975年间连续八次获得诺里斯奖。

questions.prompt: The NHL franchise who plays here was revived in 1992 and made its first Stanley Cup Final in 2007
questions.promptZh: 在这座城市效力的 NHL 球队于1992年复兴，并于2007年首次打进 Stanley Cup 总决赛
questions.story: The modern Edmonton Oilers joined the NHL in 1992 and reached their first Stanley Cup Final in 2007, losing to San Jose in six games.
questions.storyZh: 现代埃德蒙顿油人队于1992年加入 NHL，并在2007年首次打进斯坦利杯总决赛，最终以四比六负于圣何塞。

questions.prompt: Before winning 3 Hart trophies in his first 11 NHL seasons, Connor McDavid grew up here
questions.promptZh: 在首个11个 NHL 赛季中赢得3座 Hart Trophy 之前，Connor McDavid 在这里长大
questions.story: Connor McDavid was born in New Westminster on April 13, 1997, and won three consecutive Hart Trophies in 2015, 2016 and 2017.
questions.storyZh: 康纳·麦克戴维德于1997年4月13日出生在新威斯敏斯特，并在2015年、2016年和2017年连续三次获得哈特奖。

questions.prompt: Wayne Gretzky scored 1,016 points before his 21st birthday and grew up in this small city
questions.promptZh: Wayne Gretzky 在21岁生日之前得到1,016分，并在这座小城长大
questions.story: Wayne Gretzky’s hometown became synonymous with hockey greatness after he recorded 1,016 NHL points before turning 21, a record that still stands.
questions.storyZh: 韦恩·格雷茨基的家乡因一段非凡的青年时期载入史册：他在年满21岁前就收获了1,016个NHL积分，这一纪录至今仍未被打破。

questions.prompt: Back-to-back championships in '94 and '95 earned this team's home the nickname 'Clutch City'
questions.promptZh: 连续赢得1994年和1995年冠军后，这支球队的主场被称为“Clutch City”
questions.story: Raleigh earned the nickname “Clutch City” after the Carolina Hurricanes won consecutive Stanley Cups in 1994 and 1995.
questions.storyZh: 卡罗来纳飓风队在1994年和1995年连续夺得斯坦利杯，正是在这两次夺冠之后，罗利赢得了“关键之城”的称号。

questions.prompt: After this city lost Game 7 of the 2011 Stanley Cup Final, fans burned cars and looted in the downtown area
questions.promptZh: 这座城市在2011年 Stanley Cup 总决赛第七场落败后，市中心发生烧车和哄抢事件
questions.story: Vancouver’s composure broke after the Canucks lost Game 7 of the 2011 Stanley Cup Final, prompting fans to set cars ablaze and loot downtown streets.
questions.storyZh: 2011年斯坦利杯总决赛抢七战中，温哥华Canucks队败北，看台上的愤怒随后蔓延到市中心，部分球迷焚烧汽车并实施洗劫。

questions.prompt: Before relocating to Tennessee the Titans franchise had a different name and played here
questions.promptZh: 迁往 Tennessee 之前，Titans 球队使用着另一个名字，并在这座城市效力
questions.story: The franchise known as the Houston Oilers played in Texas from 1979 until 1997, when it moved to Nashville and became the Tennessee Titans.
questions.storyZh: 曾以休斯敦油人队闻名的球队自1979年至1997年在得州效力，随后迁往纳什维尔并更名为田纳西泰坦队。

questions.prompt: Before becoming the 'One-Two Three, Four, Five' Henrik, longtime Rangers goalie, Henrik Lundqvist was born here
questions.promptZh: 在成为“One-Two Three, Four, Five”Henrik 之前，Rangers 的长期守门员 Henrik Lundqvist 出生在这里
questions.story: Future Rangers goaltender Henrik Lundqvist was born in Stockholm on June 3, 1975, beginning his journey toward the nickname “The King.”
questions.storyZh: 后来成为纽约游骑兵队守门员的亨利克·伦德奎斯特于1975年6月3日出生在斯德哥尔摩，并由此开启了他“国王”的传奇生涯。

questions.prompt: Sidney Crosby grew up in this Nova Scotia town of about 25,000 people
questions.promptZh: Sidney Crosby 在这座拥有约25,000人口的 Nova Scotia 小镇长大
questions.story: Cole Harbour nurtured Sidney Crosby, who was born there in 1987 and became the first player recorded as scoring a point in every season of an NHL career.
questions.storyZh: 科尔港是悉尼·克罗斯比的成长摇篮；他于1987年出生在那里，后来成为首位在每个NXL生涯赛季都至少得到1分的球员。

questions.prompt: Fans rioted in 1955 after the NHL suspended Canadiens star Maurice 'Rocket' Richard in this city
questions.promptZh: 1955年，NHL 停赛 Canadiens 球星 Maurice “Rocket” Richard 后，这座城市的球迷发生骚乱
questions.story: A furious crowd rioted in Montreal on March 17, 1955, after the NHL suspended Canadiens star Maurice “Rocket” Richard for on-ice violence.
questions.storyZh: 1955年3月17日，NHL因场上冲突停赛了蒙特利尔Canadiens队球星莫里斯“火箭”理查德，引发当地球迷愤怒并发生骚乱。

questions.prompt: In 1993 an NHL team originally named for a Disney movie was founded by the studio here
questions.promptZh: 1993年，Disney 工作室在这里创立了一支最初以一部 Disney 电影命名的 NHL 球队
questions.story: The Los Angeles Kings were founded in 1993 by the Walt Disney Company, whose organizers initially called the club “Disney’s Kings” in reference to The King and I.
questions.storyZh: 洛杉矶国王队由华特迪士尼公司在1993年创立，创办者最初将其称为“迪士尼国王队”，名称灵感来自电影《国王与我》。

questions.prompt: A franchise whose musical name and note-shaped logo were carried from here to Utah in 1979
questions.promptZh: 这里的球队于1979年迁往Utah，并沿用了音乐名称和音符形标志
questions.story: The Colorado Rockies adopted the name Montreal Canadiens and its distinctive note-shaped logo when the franchise moved from Montreal to Utah in 1979.
questions.storyZh: 1979年，球队从蒙特利尔迁往犹他州科罗拉多时，沿用了蒙特利尔加拿大人队的队名和独特的音符形标志。

questions.prompt: Gavin McKenna, projected #1 pick in the 2026 NHL Draft, was born in this Yukon capital
questions.promptZh: 预计成为2026年NHL选秀状元秀的Gavin McKenna出生在这座Yukon首府
questions.story: Whitehorse is Gavin McKenna’s hometown; the Yukon-born winger was widely projected to be the No. 1 pick in the 2026 NHL Draft.
questions.storyZh: 加文·麦肯纳出生于白马市，这位育空省出生的边锋被广泛预测将成为2026年NHL选秀大会状元。

questions.prompt: In 2020, over 85,000 fans watched the Stars and Predators play an outdoor game at a college stadium in this city
questions.promptZh: 2020年，超过85,000名球迷在这座城市的大学体育场观看了Stars与Predators的户外比赛
questions.story: On January 1, 2020, 85,592 fans watched the Dallas Stars defeat the Nashville Predators 4-3 in an outdoor NHL game at Nissan Stadium.
questions.storyZh: 2020年1月1日，共有85,592名球迷在尼桑体育场观看达拉斯星队以4比3击败纳什维尔-predators的户外NHL比赛。

questions.prompt: After 4 years from his 'Golden Goal', Sidney Crosby won his 2nd Olympic gold in this city
questions.promptZh: 在“金球”4年后，Sidney Crosby在这座城市赢得了个人第二枚奥运金牌
questions.story: Sochi hosted the 2014 Winter Olympics, where Sidney Crosby scored the Golden Goal to give Canada its second consecutive men’s Olympic hockey gold, four years after his 2010 triumph.
questions.storyZh: 2014年，索契举办了冬季奥运会；锡尼·克罗斯比在男子冰球决赛中打进“金球”，继2010年夺冠后为加拿大队连续第二度夺得奥运金牌。

questions.prompt: ESPN has broadcast SportsCenter from its headquarters in this city since 1979
questions.promptZh: ESPN自1979年起一直在其位于这座城市的总部播出SportsCenter
questions.story: ESPN has produced SportsCenter from its Bristol headquarters since 1979, making the Connecticut town one of the program’s most recognizable homes.
questions.storyZh: 自1979年以来，ESPN一直在康涅狄格州布里斯托尔总部制作《体育中心》，这座城市因此成为该节目的标志性驻地。

questions.prompt: Sherpa guides helping climbers tackle the world's highest mountain often begin expeditions from this capital city
questions.promptZh: 帮助登山者攀登世界最高峰的夏尔巴向导，行程常从这座首都城市开始
questions.story: Kathmandu is the traditional launch point for Everest expeditions, with Sherpa mountaineers commonly helping climbers begin their journeys to the world’s highest mountain.
questions.storyZh: 加德满都是珠穆朗玛峰探险的传统出发点，夏尔巴登山者经常协助攀登者从这里启程前往世界最高峰。

questions.prompt: Every Olympic torch relay begins each Games at the original ancient stadium in this European city
questions.promptZh: 每届奥运会的火炬接力都会从这座欧洲城市的古老体育场启程
questions.story: Olympic torch relays traditionally begin at Athens’ Panathenaic Stadium, the marble venue rebuilt for the first modern Games in 1896.
questions.storyZh: 奥运火炬接力传统上从雅典的泛雅典体育场开始，这座大理石场馆曾为1896年首届现代奥运会而重建。

questions.prompt: The '94 Winter Olympics was the first to be held separately from the Summer Games. They were in this town
questions.promptZh: 1994年冬奥会首次与夏季奥运会分开举办，举办地就是这座小镇
questions.story: Lillehammer hosted the 1994 Winter Olympics, the first Winter Games held independently from the Summer Olympics since the modern movement began.
questions.storyZh: 利勒哈默尔举办了1994年冬季奥运会，这是现代奥林匹克运动会开始以来首次独立于夏季奥运会举办的冬季赛事。

questions.prompt: The last time the US hosted the Olympics was here, in the Winter of 2002
questions.promptZh: 2002年冬季，美国最后一次举办奥运会的地方就在这里
questions.story: Salt Lake City hosted the 2002 Winter Olympics, the last time the United States staged an Olympic Games until Paris 2024.
questions.storyZh: 盐湖城举办了2002年冬奥会，这是美国继2024年巴黎奥运会之前最后一次举办奥运会。

questions.prompt: In 1980, a team of U.S. college kids upset the unbeaten Soviets at the Olympics in this town
questions.promptZh: 1980年，一支美国大学队在这座小镇的奥运会上击败了保持不败的苏联队
questions.story: On February 22, 1980, the U.S. hockey team beat the undefeated Soviet Union 4–3 in Lake Placid in the famed Miracle on Ice.
questions.storyZh: 1980年2月22日，美国冰球队在普莱西德湖以4比3击败保持不败的苏联队，创造了著名的“冰上奇迹”。

questions.prompt: Charles Leclerc finally won his hometown race in 2024, ending years of heartbreak on the streets of this city
questions.promptZh: Charles Leclerc终于在2024年的家乡之战中获胜，多年心碎终告结束，赛街道穿过这座城市
questions.story: Charles Leclerc finally won his hometown Grand Prix on May 26, 2024, ending years of near misses on Monaco’s streets.
questions.storyZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔终于在2024年5月26日的家乡大奖赛中夺冠，结束了多年来在摩纳哥街道上的遗憾。

questions.prompt: F1's most prestigious race winds through this principality's casino and harbor streets every year
questions.promptZh: F1最具声望的比赛每年都会穿过这个principality的赌场与港湾街道
questions.story: Formula 1’s flagship Monaco Grand Prix winds around Monte Carlo’s casino, harbor, and narrow streets, with the race first held in 1929.
questions.storyZh: 一级方程式旗舰级的摩纳哥大奖赛蜿蜒穿过蒙特卡洛的赌场、海港和狭窄街道，这项比赛最早于1929年举行。

questions.prompt: This Florida city is home to NASCAR's most famous track
questions.promptZh: 这座佛罗里达州城市拥有 NASCAR 最著名的赛道
questions.story: Daytona Beach is home to Daytona International Speedway, where NASCAR’s most famous race, the Daytona 500, has been held since 1959.
questions.storyZh: 代托纳比奇是代托纳国际赛道的所在地，NASCAR最著名的达代托纳500自1959年起就在这里举行。

questions.prompt: Super Bowl Champion Jordan Mailata played rugby here before he was drafted by the Eagles
questions.promptZh: 超级碗冠军 Jordan Mailata 在被 Eagles 选中前曾在这里打橄榄球
questions.story: Jordan Mailata played rugby in Auckland before the Philadelphia Eagles drafted the 6-foot-8 New Zealander in 2018.
questions.storyZh: 乔丹·迈拉塔曾在奥克兰打橄榄球，之后这位身高6英尺8英寸的新西兰人被费城老鹰队于2018年选中。

questions.prompt: The All Blacks, who perform the 'Haka,' represent this nation. Its capital sits at the bottom of the North Island
questions.promptZh: 表演“Haka”的 All Blacks 代表这个国家，其首都位于北岛最南端
questions.story: Wellington has been New Zealand’s capital since 1865, and the city is a major home of the All Blacks, famous for performing the haka before matches.
questions.storyZh: 惠灵顿自1865年起一直是新西兰首都，也是以赛前表演哈卡舞而闻名的全黑队的重要基地。

questions.prompt: For 25 years, the Rugby Sevens Series stopped at this stadium, whose South Stand rained beer and worse onto the pitch
questions.promptZh: 橄榄球七人制系列赛曾在这里的体育场停办25年，其南看台还曾向球场倾倒啤酒等液体
questions.story: After being staged annually from 1979 through 2004, the Hong Kong Sevens returned to the stadium in 2011, while its notorious South Stand was known for throwing beer and debris onto the pitch.
questions.storyZh: 香港七人制橄榄球赛在1979年至2004年间每年举办，2011年重返赛场，而以向球场投掷啤酒和其他杂物闻名的南看台也长期令人难忘。

questions.prompt: Eliud Kipchoge became the first to break 2 hours in the marathon. He trains in this city
questions.promptZh: Eliud Kipchoge 成为首位突破马拉松两小时大关的人。他在这座城市训练
questions.story: Kaptagat was the training base for Eliud Kipchoge, who ran the 2019 Berlin Marathon in 1 hour 59 minutes 40.2 seconds in the first officially recorded sub-two-hour marathon.
questions.storyZh: 埃利乌德·基普乔格在卡普塔加特训练，并于2019年柏林马拉松以1小时59分40秒2秒完赛，完成了首场官方记录的突破两小时马拉松。

questions.prompt: Olympic record holder Louis Zamperini survived 47 days at sea and 2 yrs of POW torture near this city in WWII
questions.promptZh: 奥运纪录保持者 Louis Zamperini 曾在二战期间于这座城市附近海上漂流47天，并遭受两年战俘折磨
questions.story: Torrance is home to Zamperini Middle School, named for the 1936 Olympic 5,000-meter silver medalist who survived 47 days at sea and two years as a Japanese prisoner of war.
questions.storyZh: 托伦斯拥有以扎姆佩里尼命名的中学，以纪念这位在海上漂流47天、并在日本战俘营中度过两年的1936年奥运会5000米银牌得主。

questions.prompt: In the 2010 Olympics, Lindsey Vonn became the first American woman to win downhill gold, racing at this resort
questions.promptZh: 2010年奥运会上，Lindsey Vonn 成为首位夺得速降金牌的美国女性，她在这座度假胜地比赛
questions.story: At Whistler Blackcomb on February 18, 2010, Lindsey Vonn became the first American woman to win Olympic downhill skiing gold.
questions.storyZh: 2010年2月18日，琳赛·冯在惠斯勒黑梳峰夺得冬奥会高山滑雪速降金牌，成为首位赢得该项目奥运金牌的美国女性。

questions.prompt: An uncalled handball denied the USMNT a likely equalizer in a 2002 World Cup quarterfinal in this city
questions.promptZh: 2002年世界杯四分之一决赛中，一次未被判罚的手球让 USMNT 错失扳平机会，比赛在这座城市举行
questions.story: Daegu hosted the June 21, 2002 World Cup quarterfinal in which Brazil defeated the United States 2–1, including Brazil’s controversial second goal after an alleged handball.
questions.storyZh: 2002年6月21日，世界杯四分之一决赛在大邱举行巴西对美国的比赛，最终巴西以2比1获胜，其中第二个进球因疑似手球未判罚而引发争议。

questions.prompt: Born in the USA, USMNT striker Folarin Balogun left after just 2 months as a baby and grew up in this city
questions.promptZh: USMNT 前锋 Folarin Balogun 生于美国，离开时年仅2个月，并在这座城市长大
questions.story: Folarin Balogun moved from the United States to Old Bridge only two months after his birth, grew up there, and went on to become a professional footballer.
questions.storyZh: 福拉林·巴洛贡出生仅两个月便从美国移居旧大桥，在那里成长并最终成为职业足球运动员。

questions.prompt: Lionel Messi moved from Argentina at 13 to join an academy in this city
questions.promptZh: Lionel Messi 13岁时离开阿根廷，前往这座城市的青训营加盟
questions.story: Barcelona took Lionel Messi into its La Masia academy when he was 13, and he made his official Barça debut there on October 16, 2004.
questions.storyZh: 巴塞罗那在梅西13岁时将他纳入拉马西亚青训营，他于2004年10月16日在那里完成了巴萨一线队正式首秀。

questions.prompt: The World Cup kicks off in 30 days at this storied stadium in the capital city of one of the 3 host countries
questions.promptZh: 世界杯将在30天后于这座历史悠久的体育场开幕，它位于三个主办国之一的首都
questions.story: The 2026 FIFA World Cup will begin in Mexico City at the Estadio Azteca on June 11, with the tournament also staged in Guadalajara and Monterrey.
questions.storyZh: 2026年国际足联世界杯将于6月11日在墨西哥城的阿兹特克体育场揭幕，赛事还将在瓜达拉哈拉和蒙特雷举行。

questions.prompt: Lionel Messi was born in this Argentine city with a growth-hormone deficiency his club couldn't treat
questions.promptZh: Lionel Messi 出生在这座阿根廷城市，俱乐部无法治疗他的生长激素缺乏症
questions.story: Lionel Messi was born in Rosario on June 24, 1987, and began his youth career with Newell’s Old Boys, where doctors treated his childhood growth-hormone deficiency.
questions.storyZh: 梅西于1987年6月24日出生在罗萨里奥，并在纽维尔老男孩开始青训生涯，俱乐部医生曾治疗他幼年时的生长激素缺乏症。

questions.prompt: Pelé was born in 1940 in this small Brazilian town in Minas Gerais state
questions.promptZh: Pelé于1940年出生在明纳斯吉拉斯州这座巴西小镇
questions.story: Pelé was born in Três Corações on October 23, 1940, before becoming Brazil’s three-time World Cup champion. The town remains closely tied to the famous “Black Pearl.”
questions.storyZh: 贝利于1940年10月23日出生在特雷斯科拉松斯，后来成为三届世界杯冠军。这座小镇至今仍与“黑珍珠”的传奇紧密相连。

questions.prompt: The only African player to win the Ballon d'Or, later became his country's president. He was born in this West African capital and his son plays for the USMNT
questions.promptZh: 这位西非首都出生的球员是唯一获评金球奖的非洲球员，后来成为祖国总统，他的儿子效力于USMNT
questions.story: George Weah was born in Dakar in 1966, won the 1995 Ballon d’Or, and served as Liberia’s president from 2018 to 2024. His son Timothy Weah has represented the United States men’s national team.
questions.storyZh: 乔治·维阿于1966年出生在达喀尔，获得1995年金球奖，并于2018年至2024年担任利比里亚总统。他的儿子蒂莫西·维阿曾代表美国男足国家队出场。

questions.prompt: The 2014 World Cup's opening match was played in this Brazilian city
questions.promptZh: 2014年世界杯揭幕战在这座巴西城市举行
questions.story: São Paulo hosted the opening match of the 2014 FIFA World Cup on June 12, when Brazil defeated Croatia 3–1 at Arena Corinthians. It was the tournament’s first match and the country’s first World Cup opening in 64 years.
questions.storyZh: 2014年6月12日，圣保罗在科林蒂安竞技场主办国际足联世界杯揭幕战，巴西以3比1战胜克罗地亚。这是该届赛事的首场比赛，也是巴西时隔64年再次主办世界杯揭幕战。

questions.prompt: The 1950 Maracanazo, the 'Maracanazo', happened in this Brazilian city
questions.promptZh: 1950年的“马拉卡纳惨案”就发生在这座巴西城市
questions.story: Rio de Janeiro witnessed the “Maracanazo” on July 16, 1950, when Uruguay defeated Brazil 2–1 before a crowd of nearly 200,000. The result remains one of football’s most famous shocks.
questions.storyZh: 1950年7月16日，近20万名观众在里约见证了“马拉卡纳打击”，乌拉圭以2比1击败巴西。这个结果至今仍是足球史上最著名的冷门之一。

questions.prompt: In 2014, US keeper Tim Howard set a World Cup record with 16 saves in a knockout match played here
questions.promptZh: 2014年，美国门将Tim Howard在一场于此举行的淘汰赛中扑出16次，创下世界杯纪录
questions.story: Tim Howard made a World Cup-record 16 saves against Belgium at Cape Town’s Green Point Stadium on June 27, 2010, helping the United States win 2–1. The performance came in the round of 16.
questions.storyZh: 2010年6月27日，蒂姆·霍华德在开普敦绿灯球场对阵比利时时完成世界杯纪录的16次扑救，帮助美国以2比1取胜，并将球队送入16强。

questions.prompt: Diego Maradona's 'Goal of the Century' was scored in this city in 1986
questions.promptZh: Diego Maradona的“世纪进球”于1986年在这座城市打进
questions.story: Diego Maradona scored his “Goal of the Century” in Mexico City on June 22, 1986, dribbling past several English defenders before finding the net. FIFA later recognized it as the greatest goal of the 20th century.
questions.storyZh: 1986年6月22日，迭戈·马拉多纳在墨西哥城连续晃过多名英格兰后卫后进球得分。被国际足联认定为20世纪最佳进球。

questions.prompt: Roberto Baggio's 1994 World Cup penalty miss happened in this American city
questions.promptZh: Roberto Baggio在1994年世界杯罚失的点球发生在这座美国城市
questions.story: Roberto Baggio’s infamous penalty miss for Italy against Spain occurred at Dallas’s Cotton Bowl on July 4, 1994. His failed kick ended Italy’s hopes in the knockout round of that World Cup.
questions.storyZh: 1994年7月4日，罗伯托·巴乔在达拉斯棉花球场代表意大利对阵西班牙时罚失点球。这粒失点终结了意大利在该届世界杯淘汰赛中的希望。

questions.prompt: This Italian club's 'Curva Nord' banners hung over this city's stands
questions.promptZh: 这家意大利俱乐部的“Curva Nord”横幅曾悬挂在这座城市的看台上
questions.story: Turin is home to Juventus and its famous Curva Nord supporters, whose choreographed banners have filled the northern stands for decades. The city’s identity is inseparable from the club’s black-and-white tradition.
questions.storyZh: 都灵是尤文图斯的主场，著名的北看台球迷组织“Curva Nord”数十年来用编排有序的横幅装点看台。这座城市与俱乐部的黑白传统密不可分。

questions.prompt: The 2002 World Cup final was held in this Japanese city
questions.promptZh: 2002年世界杯决赛在这座日本城市举行
questions.story: Yokohama Stadium hosted the 2002 FIFA World Cup final on June 30, when Brazil defeated Germany 2–0 for its fifth world title.
questions.storyZh: 2002年6月30日，横滨体育场举行世界杯决赛，巴西以2比0击败德国，赢得第五座世界杯冠军奖杯。

questions.prompt: Arsenal, chasing their first Premier League title since 2004, plays its home games here
questions.promptZh: Arsenal主场作战在这座城市，正争夺自2004年以来首个英超冠军
questions.story: Arsenal completed its Premier League return at London’s Emirates Stadium by winning the 2024–25 title, its first league championship since 2004.
questions.storyZh: 阿森纳在伦敦的酋长球场夺得2024至2025赛季英超冠军，这是球队自2004年以来首个联赛冠军。

questions.prompt: Cristiano Ronaldo was born and raised here before leaving at 12 years old
questions.promptZh: Cristiano Ronaldo在这里出生并长大，12岁前离开
questions.story: Cristiano Ronaldo was born in Funchal on February 5, 1982, and left his home island of Madeira for Sporting CP at age 12.
questions.storyZh: 克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多于1982年2月5日出生在丰沙尔，并在12岁时离开马德拉岛前往里斯本竞技。

questions.prompt: In 2025, the Dolphins and Commanders played a game at Santiago Bernabeu, which is located here
questions.promptZh: 2025年，Dolphins与Commanders在这座城市的Santiago Bernabéu球场比赛
questions.story: Madrid’s Santiago Bernabéu hosted the Miami Dolphins and Washington Commanders on January 19, 2025, bringing a regular-season NFL game to Spain for the first time.
questions.storyZh: 2025年1月19日，迈阿密海豚队与华盛顿指挥官队在马德里的伯纳乌球场交锋，这是NFL常规赛首次登陆西班牙。

questions.prompt: This is the city where the Ajax dynasty of the 1970s was born
questions.promptZh: Ajax的黄金时代诞生于这座城市
questions.story: Amsterdam was the home of Ajax’s celebrated 1970s dynasty, whose team won three consecutive European Cups from 1971 through 1973.
questions.storyZh: 阿姆斯特丹是阿贾克斯辉煌1970年代的主场，这支球队在1971年至1973年间连续三度赢得欧洲冠军杯。

questions.prompt: Total football was invented by a teacher at this school in this Dutch city
questions.promptZh: 全民足球由一位老师在这座荷兰城市的这所学校发明
questions.story: Total Football was introduced in the Dutch city of Narrow by schoolteacher John Langenus, whose classroom experiments helped shape the Netherlands’ distinctive passing style in the 1970s.
questions.storyZh: 荷兰城市诺罗由学校教师约翰·朗赫努斯引入“全能足球”，他的课堂实验帮助塑造了荷兰队在1970年代鲜明的传球风格。

questions.prompt: Diego Maradona, scorer of the 'Hand of God' and 'Goal of the Century' in 1986, grew up near this capital
questions.promptZh: 打进1986年世界杯“上帝之手”和“世纪进球”的Diego Maradona在这座首都附近长大
questions.story: Buenos Aires is where Diego Maradona grew up in the Villa Fiorito neighborhood before becoming the star of Argentina’s 1986 World Cup victory.
questions.storyZh: 迭戈·马拉多纳在布宜诺斯艾利斯的维拉·菲奥里托区长大，后来成为阿根廷赢得1986年世界杯的明星。

questions.prompt: The Running of the Bulls takes place every July during The San Fermín Festival in this European city

questions.storyZh: 贝斯佩奇州立公园拥有五座球场，24岁的泰格·伍兹曾在其中的黑球场赢得2002年美国公开赛。

questions.prompt: This town's course hosted the 2003 U.S. Open, won by Justin Leonard.
questions.promptZh: 这座小镇的球场承办了2003年美国公开赛。
questions.story: Justin Leonard won the 2003 U.S. Open at Olympia Fields, and Rory McIlroy won the 2012 edition at age 22.
questions.storyZh: 贾斯汀·伦纳德赢得了2003年奥林匹亚菲尔兹美国公开赛，22岁的罗里·麦克罗伊则夺得了2012年赛事冠军。

questions.prompt: The course that hosted the 1999, 2008 and 2016 US Opens is located here in Minnesota.
questions.promptZh: 明尼苏达州这座城市的球场举办过三届美国公开赛。
questions.story: Hazeltine National Golf Club opened in 1962 and was designed by Robert Trent Jones Sr.
questions.storyZh: 黑泽尔廷国家高尔夫俱乐部于1962年开放，由罗伯特·特伦特·琼斯一世设计。

questions.prompt: The 1896 US Open, the first edition, was played here on this New York course.
questions.promptZh: 纽约州这座小镇在1896年举办了首届美国公开赛。
questions.story: Shinnecock Hills hosted the 1986 PGA Championship, which Bob Tway won with a hole-in-one on the final hole.
questions.storyZh: 1986年PGA锦标赛在辛尼霍克山举行，鲍勃·特威在最后一洞打出一杆进洞。

questions.prompt: The 1998 US Open was played here on a course on this Massachusetts island.
questions.promptZh: 马萨诸塞州这座海岛的球场曾举办1998年美国公开赛。
questions.story: The Martha's Vineyard Golf Club's current course was redesigned by Donald Ross in 1924.
questions.storyZh: 玛莎葡萄园高尔夫俱乐部的现有球场由唐纳德·罗斯于1924年重新设计。

questions.prompt: The 1991 US Open was played here on a course in this Florida city.
questions.promptZh: 佛罗里达州这座城市的主球场曾举办1991年美国公开赛。
questions.story: The Biltmore Hotel's course hosted the 1926 PGA Championship, won by Walter Hagen.
questions.storyZh: 比尔特莫尔酒店的球场举办了1926年PGA锦标赛，冠军是沃尔特·哈根。

questions.prompt: This Florida city is home to O'Shea's and hosted the 2006 Senior PGA Championship.
questions.promptZh: 佛罗里达州这座城市有奥谢斯，亦举办2006年PGA元老赛。
questions.story: Tom Watson won the 2006 Senior PGA Championship at John's Pass Village by four strokes.
questions.storyZh: 汤姆·沃特森在约翰斯帕斯村举行的2006年高级PGA锦标赛中以四杆优势夺冠。

questions.prompt: The PGA Grand Slam of Golf is hosted here at a resort on this Hawaiian island.
questions.promptZh: 夏威夷这座岛屿的度假村举办PGA高尔夫大满贯赛。
questions.story: The inaugural 1999 PGA Grand Slam of Golf was won by Tiger Woods at Mauna Kea Beach.
questions.storyZh: 1999年首届PGA高尔夫大满贯赛由老虎·伍兹在Mauna Kea Beach夺冠。

questions.prompt: This Australian town in Victoria's Yarra Ranges is home to the golf course that hosted the 2006 Presidents Cup.
questions.promptZh: 这座位于维多利亚州亚拉山脉的小镇，其高尔夫球场曾举办2006年总统杯。
questions.story: The Montrose course in Victoria's Yarra Ranges hosted the 2006 Presidents Cup meeting between the United States team and the International team.
questions.storyZh: 维多利亚州亚拉山脉的蒙特罗斯球场举办了2006年总统杯，对阵美国队与国际队。

questions.prompt: This Australian course near Melbourne hosted the 2018 Presidents Cup, which the International team won.
questions.promptZh: 这座墨尔本附近的澳大利亚球场举办了2018年总统杯，最终由国际队夺冠。
questions.story: The 2018 Presidents Cup was the twelfth edition of the event, played at Royal Melbourne Golf Club, where the International team won 10.5 to 7.5 behind Tiger Woods' three victories.
questions.storyZh: 2018年总统杯是该项赛事的第十二届，在墨尔本皇家高尔夫俱乐部举行，国际队以10.5比7.5获胜，泰格·伍兹贡献三场胜利。

questions.prompt: This Scottish links course hosted the 2017 Dunhill Links Championship and later staged The Open in 2022.
questions.promptZh: 这座苏格兰林克斯球场举办了2017年邓利尔林克斯赛，并在2022年承办了英国公开赛。
questions.story: Kingsbarns staged the 2022 Open Championship, the first major championship ever held on the course, and Zach Johnson won with a final-round 65.
questions.storyZh: 金斯巴恩斯举办了2022年英国公开赛，这是该球场承办的首场大满贯赛事，扎克·约翰逊最后一轮打出65杆夺冠。

questions.prompt: This Scottish links town on the Sutherland coast is famed for the 1995 Open Championship runner-up finish.
questions.promptZh: 这座位于萨瑟兰海岸的苏格兰林克斯小镇，因1995年英国公开赛的亚军成绩而闻名。
questions.story: Royal Dornoch, laid out by Willie Fernie and opened in 1903, is one of Scotland's most celebrated links courses and a regular Open Championship qualifying venue.
questions.storyZh: 皇家多诺赫由威利·弗尼设计，1903年启用，是苏格兰最受推崇的林克斯球场之一，也是英国公开赛资格赛的常办场地。

questions.prompt: This Irish links course hosted the 2012 US Open, which a player won by three strokes.
questions.promptZh: 这座爱尔兰林克斯球场举办了2012年美国公开赛，冠军以三杆优势夺冠。
questions.story: Rory McIlroy won the 2012 US Open at Doonbeg by three strokes over Jason Day, claiming his first PGA Tour title.
questions.storyZh: 罗里·麦克罗伊在杜恩贝格赢得2012年美国公开赛，以三杆优势击败杰森·戴，这也是他的首座美巡赛冠军。

questions.prompt: This Bahamian capital is home to the Ocean Club, which hosted the 2012 PGA Championship.
questions.promptZh: 这座巴哈马首都拥有的大西洋俱乐部举办了2012年PGA锦标赛。
questions.story: The Ocean Club in Nassau hosted the 2012 PGA Championship, where Rory McIlroy won by two strokes over Martin Kaymer.
questions.storyZh: 拿骚的大西洋俱乐部举办了2012年PGA锦标赛，罗里·麦克罗伊以两杆优势击败马丁·凯默夺冠。

questions.prompt: This city-state’s waterfront course hosted the inaugural international open in 1963 for professional golfers.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的滨海球场于1963年举办了首届国际公开赛。
questions.story: Charlie Coody won the inaugural Singapore Open in 1963. The tournament was held at Marina Bay Golf Course.
questions.storyZh: 查理·库迪赢得了1963年首届新加坡公开赛。该赛事在滨海湾高尔夫球场举行。

questions.prompt: This coastal city’s mission-style course hosts the Volvo-branded professional golf event each spring.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的传教风格球场每年春季举办沃尔沃职业公开赛。
questions.story: The Volvo China Open debuted in 1994 at Mission Hills Golf Club in Shenzhen. The same club hosted the event again in 2013.
questions.storyZh: 沃尔沃中国公开赛于1994年在深圳的观澜湖高尔夫俱乐部首次举行。该俱乐部在2013年再次承办了这项赛事。

questions.prompt: This seaside resort town’s course hosted the 2019 Asia-Pacific Open for professional golfers.
questions.promptZh: 这个海滨小镇的球场举办了2019年亚太公开赛。
questions.story: The 2019 Asia-Pacific Open was played at Hirono Golf Club in Hirono, Japan. Yani Tseng won the tournament.
questions.storyZh: 2019年亚太公开赛在日本广野的广野高尔夫俱乐部举行。雅尼·曾赢得该届赛事冠军。

questions.prompt: This western Alpine town’s course hosted the European Tour’s national open from 2015 to 2024.
questions.promptZh: 这个阿尔卑斯小镇的球场曾承办欧洲巡回赛本土公开赛。
questions.story: The Austrian Open was staged at Golfclub Dornbirn from 2015 through 2024. Martin Schläff won the 2015 event.
questions.storyZh: 奥地利公开赛于2015年至2024年在多恩比恩高尔夫俱乐部举行。马丁·施莱夫赢得了2015年赛事。

questions.prompt: This continental course hosted the 2018 Ryder Cup, won by Team Europe.
questions.promptZh: 这座欧洲球场举办了2018年莱德杯，欧洲队获胜。
questions.story: Le Golf National hosted the 2018 Ryder Cup near Paris. Europe defeated the United States 17½–8½.
questions.storyZh: 国家高尔夫俱乐部在巴黎附近举办了2018年莱德杯。欧洲队以17½比8½击败美国队。

questions.prompt: This golf course hosted the 2003 and 2015 editions of the PGA Championship.
questions.promptZh: 这里在2003年和2015年两度举办PGA锦标赛。
questions.story: Whistling Straits hosted the PGA Championship in 2003 and 2015. Tiger Woods won in 2003, while Justin Rose won in 2015.
questions.storyZh: 哨兵海峡球场在2003年和2015年两度承办PGA锦标赛。泰格·伍兹赢得2003年冠军，贾斯汀·罗斯赢得2015年冠军。

questions.prompt: This golf course hosted the PGA Championship in 2005, 2013, and 2022.
questions.promptZh: 这座球场在三个年份举办过PGA锦标赛。
questions.story: Ben Hogan helped design the course in 1947, and Perry Maxwell Sr. rebuilt it in 1976.
questions.storyZh: 本·霍根于1947年参与设计这座球场，佩里·麦克斯韦尔父子随后于1976年对其重建。

questions.prompt: Before 2021, this club had hosted five editions of the US Open.
questions.promptZh: 这家俱乐部曾举办五届美国公开赛。
questions.story: The club staged its sixth U.S. Open in 2021, five years after its previous championship in 1995.
questions.storyZh: 该俱乐部于2021年举办了第六届美国公开赛，前五届中的最近一届是在1995年。

questions.prompt: This city hosts the tennis calendar's first Grand Slam of the year.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办每年首项网球大满贯赛事。
questions.story: The Australian Open was first played in 1905 and has been held at Melbourne Park since 1988.
questions.storyZh: 澳大利亚网球公开赛于1905年首次举办，自1988年以来一直在墨尔本公园举行。

questions.prompt: This city hosts tennis's oldest major, which has been played on grass since 1877.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的大满贯自1877年起一直在草地上进行。
questions.story: The women's singles championship was first contested in 1884.
questions.storyZh: 女子单打锦标赛于1884年首次开赛。

questions.prompt: This city hosts one of the four tennis majors, played entirely on clay.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办一项全程在红土上进行的网球大满贯。
questions.story: The tournament's modern incarnation began in 1891, when it was known as the French Championships.
questions.storyZh: 这项赛事的现代形式始于1891年，当时称为法国锦标赛。

questions.prompt: This city hosts the final tennis Grand Slam of the calendar year.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办每年最后一项网球大满贯赛事。
questions.story: The US Open moved to its current home at Flushing Meadows in 1978.
questions.storyZh: 美国网球公开赛于1978年迁至今日的法拉盛赛场。

questions.prompt: This city hosts a prestigious Masters 1000 tennis tournament played on clay in spring.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市每年举办春季红土场的1000分大师赛网球赛。
questions.story: The 2022 men's final was the first Masters 1000 final to be played as best of five sets.
questions.storyZh: 2022年男单决赛成为首场采用五盘三胜制的1000分大师赛决赛。

questions.prompt: This city hosts a spring clay-court Masters 1000 tournament staged at its historic national tennis complex.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市在国家网球中心举办红土场1000分大师赛。
questions.story: The tournament has been held at the Foro Italico since 2009.
questions.storyZh: 该赛事自2009年起一直在福尔意大利科举行。

questions.prompt: This city hosts the National Bank Open, a summer Masters 1000 tournament on hard courts.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办名为国家银行公开赛的1000分大师赛。
questions.story: The tournament returned to this city in 2021 after being cancelled in 2020.
questions.storyZh: 该赛事在2020年取消后，于2021年重返这座城市。

questions.prompt: This city hosts a summer hard-court Masters 1000 tournament still known by a traditional country-derived title.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办沿用国名的夏季硬地场1000分大师赛。
questions.story: The tournament was first held in this city in 1974.
questions.storyZh: 该赛事于1974年首次在这座城市举办。

questions.prompt: This Ohio city hosts a summer Masters 1000 tournament whose event was upgraded in 2009.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的赛事于2009年升级为1000分大师赛。
questions.story: Rafael Nadal won the singles title here a record ten times.
questions.storyZh: 拉斐尔·纳达尔曾十次在这里赢得男单冠军，创下赛事纪录。

questions.prompt: This city hosts an autumn Masters 1000 tennis tournament played on outdoor hard courts.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市每年举办秋季室外硬地场的1000分大师赛。
questions.story: The tournament was first held in this city in 2009.
questions.storyZh: 该赛事于2009年首次在这座城市举办。

questions.prompt: This Spanish capital staged the ATP Masters Series here from 2002 to 2006 and now hosts a clay-court tournament.
questions.promptZh: 这座西班牙首都曾在2002年至2006年举办ATP大师赛。
questions.story: The Masters Series event ran in the Spanish capital for five seasons before merging into the Monte Carlo Masters in 2007.
questions.storyZh: 该大师赛在这座西班牙首都连续举办五季后，于2007年并入蒙特卡洛大师赛。

questions.prompt: This Serbian capital hosted the 2009 ATP World Tour Finals and is home to a golden generation of tennis champions.
questions.promptZh: 这座塞尔维亚首都曾举办2009年ATP年终总决赛。
questions.story: Novak Djokovic, Ana Ivanovic and Jelena Jankovic all came through the Red Star Tennis Club in the Serbian capital.
questions.storyZh: 德约科维奇、伊万诺维奇和扬科维奇都出自该市的红星网球俱乐部。

questions.prompt: This Serbian city saw Djokovic claim his first Masters title in 2006 and hosted the season-ending world championships in the 1990s.
questions.promptZh: 这座塞尔维亚城市见证德约科维奇2006年首夺大师赛冠军。
questions.story: The season-ending World Championships were staged in Novi Sad from 1990 to 1995, before moving on to Stuttgart.
questions.storyZh: 年终世界锦标赛曾于1990年至1995年在诺维萨德举行，随后移往斯图加特。

questions.prompt: This Italian city hosted the season-ending ATP Finals for five consecutive editions, from 2018 through 2022.
questions.promptZh: 这座意大利城市曾连续五届举办ATP年终总决赛。
questions.story: The Italian Open in Turin is one of the oldest clay-court tournaments in the world, played since 1930.
questions.storyZh: 都灵的意大利公开赛是世界上最古老的红土赛事之一，创办于1930年。

questions.prompt: This British capital hosts the season-ending ATP Finals inside the O2 Arena, the tournament's home since 2011.
questions.promptZh: 这座英国首都的O2体育馆自2011年起承办ATP年终总决赛。
questions.story: The O2 Arena staged the ATP Finals in 2011, 2012 and 2013 before the tournament moved on to Shanghai.
questions.storyZh: O2体育馆在2011至2013年举办ATP总决赛，之后赛事移师上海。

questions.prompt: This Swiss city has staged an indoor hard-court tournament since 1975, one of the tour's oldest events.
questions.promptZh: 这座瑞士城市自1975年起举办一项室内硬地赛事。
questions.story: Since 2009 the Swiss Indoors has been played at St. Jakobshalle, following earlier editions at the Mustermesse fairground.
questions.storyZh: 自2009年起，瑞士室内赛改在圣雅各布会堂举行，此前在展览中心举行。

questions.prompt: This city hosts the country's oldest clay-court tennis tournament, which was founded in 1897.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办该国历史最悠久的红土网球赛。
questions.story: Rafael Nadal won his first ATP singles title at this tournament in 1995, at the age of 17.
questions.storyZh: 拉斐尔·纳达尔于1995年在该赛事赢得个人首个ATP单打冠军，当时年仅17岁。

questions.prompt: This town hosts a grass-court tennis tournament that has run continuously since 1993.
questions.promptZh: 这个小镇的草地网球赛自1993年起持续举办。
questions.story: The tournament is held at the OWL Arena, and Novak Djokovic has won its singles title six times.
questions.storyZh: 该赛事在OWL竞技场举行，诺瓦克·德约科维奇曾六次夺得单打冠军。

questions.prompt: This city hosts the oldest tennis tournament in the world, whose origins date to 1099.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办世界上最古老的网球赛事。
questions.story: The tournament's modern edition began in 1895 before the event moved to Rome in 1911.
questions.storyZh: 该赛事的现代版本始于1895年，并于1911年迁往罗马。

questions.prompt: This city hosted the Summer Olympics in 1964 and again in 2020.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市分别在1964与2020年举办夏季奥运会。
questions.story: The 2020 Games were postponed by one year because of COVID-19, but retained their original name.
questions.storyZh: 2020年奥运会因新冠疫情推迟一年举行，但保留了原赛事名称。

questions.prompt: This city gave birth to the modern Olympic movement and hosted the first modern Games in 1896.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是现代奥运会的发源地，并举办了首届现代赛事。
questions.story: The 1896 Games featured 43 events across 10 sports and included the first Olympic marathon.
questions.storyZh: 1896年奥运会共设10个大项、43个小项，并举行了首届奥运马拉松比赛。

questions.prompt: This Georgia city is where a Falcons receiver set the franchise career receiving yards record.
questions.promptZh: 一位猎鹰队接球手创下队史生涯接球码数纪录的地方就是这座乔治亚州城市。
questions.story: Roddy White spent all 11 seasons of his NFL career with the Atlanta Falcons and retired as the franchise leader in career receiving yards.
questions.storyZh: 罗迪·怀特的整个 NFL 生涯11个赛季都效力于亚特兰大猎鹰队，退役时是该队生涯接球码数纪录保持者。
